target: Journal; scope and venue remain conditional on evidence
runtime_definition: Sum of additional Kaggle notebook session runtime caps, including setup; not device-hours. Prior completed pilot excluded.
compute_location: Kaggle only; one T4 device used per notebook
primary_estimand: Fine-tuning recipe differences in clean mAP50-95 across image availability and independent missing-box probability, at fixed image exposures and optimizer updates
sampling: Continuous deterministic shuffled cyclic stream; epoch boundaries only define schedule and validation events. Actual ordered image hashes checked between paired optimizers.
validation: Clean held-out wildlife split and 512 deterministic VOC2007 official-validation images; no test scores used in tuning
voc_policy: Official 2007 train/val/test membership. All difficult objects retained with inclusive-coordinate conversion; controlled VOC-derived mAP50-95, not official VOC AP.

deduplication.scope: Conservative cross-split image screen; not an exhaustive scene/entity audit
deduplication.review_chronology: One additional likely same-scene wildlife training image excluded after preflight input review, before main submission; pilot remains unchanged.

default_controls: AdamW and MuSGD variable rounded exposure vs fixed exposure, plus fixed-exposure SGD; one development block; descriptive only

tuning.selection: One global setting per optimizer maximizing mean clean-validation anchor mAP; ties lower LR then lower decay
tuning.schedule_transfer: 10-block-selected settings transferred to 20/60 blocks without retuning
tuning.boundary_extension: If any selected LR is on its boundary and mandatory confirmation time remains, add two candidates per optimizer on two anchors at 10 blocks. Extend high if best is high; otherwise extend low. Equal candidate budgets, all failures retained.

optional_priority: 60-block wildlife AdamW/MuSGD at q=0.2, both fractions, block 101
MuSGD 1x head LR ablation, four cells, block 101; selected LR transferred
final_test: Open only after both datasets complete all three required joint blocks and no attempted confirmation block is incomplete. Freeze checkpoint bytes, identities and settings before scoring. Evaluate all selected complete confirmation cells once; record all failures and partial evaluations. No retuning after test access.
analysis: Paired block contrasts and three-way difference-in-differences in AP points, approximate Student t 95% intervals across joint blocks. At n=3 intervals are weak; exploratory cell comparisons without multiplicity claims. No image-level bootstrap inference from block intervals.
limitations: Recipe comparison includes optimizer-specific grouping, native precision and head LR multiplier
One pretrained checkpoint lineage; possible training-image overlap unresolved
Short fixed-update budget does not establish convergence
Tuning at one development block and shorter horizon may transfer imperfectly
Dataset rights must be resolved before image redistribution
Targeted prior-art search is not exhaustive
